messages.content: You are a helpful, creative, and smart assistant.
Write a poem about Mike and Joe becoming millionaires by leveraging the power of AI to become the greatest Agile coaches in history. Include content from the agile manifesto.

message.content:
Mike and Joe, two clever chaps,
With Agile wisdom, they've captured the maps.
With AI's power, they've crafted their plan,
To become millionaires, the Agile way, they began.

The Agile Manifesto, they understood well,
"Individuals and interactions" were key to their cell.
"Working software" was the goal, they'd agree,
With "customer collaboration", they'd see.

Mike and Joe, with their Agile approach,
"Responding to change" was their daily routine.
With "simplicity" in their methods, they'd choose,
And "self-organizing teams" to lead the news.

Their million-dollar journey, with Agile in tow,
"Continuous improvement" was their daily goal.
With "customer satisfaction" at the core,
They became millionaires, Agile forevermore.

Once upon a time, in a land of code,
Lived two friends, Mike and Joe, who shared a node.
Their hearts beat to the rhythm of Agile's lore,
Seeking to transform the way software is scored.

They toiled and they coded, late into the night,
Their minds ablaze with Agile's piercing light.
Their eyes sparkled with the wisdom of the Agile creed,
As they embarked on a journey that would soon need.

With AI as their ally, a force to be reckoned,
They harnessed its power, their Agile dreams to be sped.
From principles to practices, they crafted and they spun,
A tapestry of Agile that would soon be undone.

They spoke of individuals and interactions,
And the value of their work, not just the solutions.
They embraced the need for a constant flow,
A continuous improvement, as the Agile manifesto shows.

They honored customer collaboration,
Over contract negotiation, that's what they'd say.
They strived for a working product,
That met the customer's needs, day by day.

With Mike and Joe's guidance, Agile coaches were born,
Their knowledge and expertise, from the bottom to the top.
They coached and they inspired, their legacy so strong,
That Agile coaches everywhere would sing their song.

And so it came to pass, in a world of software code,
That Mike and Joe, through their passion and their drive,
Became millionaires, Agile coaches supreme,
And their names would be remembered in the Agile dream.

Two friends, Mike and Joe, with dreams so bright,
They saw the power of AI in the darkest night.
Together, they vowed to climb to great heights,
Using Agile principles to create the best software sites.

Their journey began with a spark of an idea,
To use Agile to transform the world, a feat so grand.
They embraced the Agile Manifesto's core values,
Collaborating closely, delivering value.

They started small, with a team of a few,
But as their reputation grew, so did their crew.
They learned to embrace change, to adapt and grow,
And to deliver value, quickly and with a flow.

Their clients were amazed, their projects so grand,
They delivered on time, with a quality hand.
They embraced the Agile principles, in every way,
And with the help of AI, they were here to stay.

They became millionaires, in more ways than one,
Their Agile coaching business, a success to be run.
They inspired others to follow in their wake,
To embrace Agile, and let the magic take.

So here's to Mike and Joe, and their Agile ways,
Their legacy will live on, in the Agile space.
They showed the world what could be achieved,
With the power of Agile, and the wisdom to believe.

Mike and Joe, once just two,
Determined to succeed, as true,
They set out on a journey wild,
To become the Agile world's idol.

With the power of AI,
They unlocked a door,
To greatness and success,
To become the greatest coaches of all.

"Individuals and interactions over processes and tools" they said,
"Working software over comprehensive documentation",
These were the words that guided them,
As they became millionaires,
In the world of Agile.

They wrote books, they gave talks,
They spread the Agile gospel,
And now, the world is theirs,
As they bask in their riches.

But through it all, they never lost sight,
Of the Agile manifesto's true power,
To deliver value,
And to make the world a better place,
One Agile coach at a time.

Mike and Joe were two men on a mission,
To make a fortune using AI's precision.
They started small, with just a simple plan,
To revolutionize the Agile world, they began.

With the agile manifesto as their guide,
They worked together, side by side.
Individuals and interactions over processes and tools,
Customer collaboration over contract negotiation,
Responding to change over following a plan,
And delivering value through working software.

Mike and Joe knew that these principles were key,
To success in the world of Agile, they'd see.
They trained and coached, with passion and care,
And used AI to help them everywhere.

With the power of AI, they reached new heights,
Their coaching skills were unmatched in their sights.
They became millionaires, successful and grand,
And their name would be remembered, in every Agile band.

So here's to Mike and Joe, the greatest of all,
The Agile coaches who made it all.
Their journey is a testament to the power of AI,
And the agile manifesto that they never swayed.
